ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
<image>In $\odot R, S U=20, Y W=20,$ and $m \widehat{Y X}=45$.
Find $m\widehat{Y W}$
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a circle with R as the center, S, R, Z, X are on the same straight line, and S and X are on the circle, so SX is a diameter. Diameter SX intersects chord YW at Z, and there is a right-angle mark at the point of intersection, indicating that SX is perpendicular to YW. Point X is located on the minor arc from Y to W. Reasoning: A diameter passing through the center of a circle and perpendicular to a chord will bisect that chord and the arcs it intercepts. Therefore X is the midpoint of minor arc YW, so arc YX and arc XW are equal. Given m arc YX = 45, then m arc XW = 45, so m arc YW = 45 + 45 = 90.

Therefore X is the midpoint of minor arc YW, so arc YX = arc XW = 45, and m arc YW = 45 + 45 = 90.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram first: R is the center, YW is a chord, Z lies on YW, and RZ is perpendicular to YW; X lies on the same ray from R through Z to the circle. From the text, m arc YX = 45. Instead of citing the arc-bisection theorem directly, form right triangles RZY and RZW. Since RY and RW are radii, RY = RW; RZ is common; and both triangles are right triangles, so they are congruent. Thus the central angles on the two sides of RX are equal: angle YRX = angle XRW. Because m arc YX = 45, angle YRX = 45, so angle XRW = 45, giving central angle YRW = 90 and therefore m arc YW = 90.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是以 R 为圆心的圆。Y 和 W 是圆上的点，YW 是一条弦；点 Z 在弦 YW 上，且从圆心 R 到 Z 的线段垂直于弦 YW。点 X 在圆上，并且 X、Z、R 在同一直线上，X 位于从 R 经过 Z 的同一射线上。题目给出 m弧YX = 45。

推理：考虑直角三角形 RZY 和 RZW。RY 与 RW 都是圆的半径，所以 RY = RW；RZ 是公共边；并且 RZ 垂直 YW，所以两个三角形都是直角三角形。因此 △RZY ≅ △RZW。于是对应的圆心角相等，即 ∠YRX = ∠XRW。因为 m弧YX = 45，所以对应圆心角 ∠YRX = 45°，从而 ∠XRW = 45°。因此 ∠YRW = 45° + 45° = 90°。弧 YW 的度数等于圆心角 ∠YRW，所以 m弧YW = 90。
